Eden (PM): Quick design check: small onboarding strip in empty-project view to surface sample projects + quickstart CTA. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9101/onboard-strip. Need layout + copy + a11y thumbs before QA.

Kai (Designer): Two layouts: Tiles (stacked) vs. Mosaic (two-up). Tiles simpler for mobile. Added frames in figma.

Maya (Frontend): I'll build both behind a flag. A few asks: lazy-load images, CSS-only animations, analytics events names?

Eden (PM): Events: `onboard_strip_impress`, `onboard_strip_click`, `onboard_strip_dismiss`. Animation: subtle 600ms pulse on CTA, respect prefers-reduced-motion. Mobile: single stacked card, no carousel.

Lina (A11y): Accessibility notes: color contrast >=4.5 for body text, 44px touch targets, clear focus ring (outline-offset), images need meaningful alt text from API, avoid auto-rotating carousels or ensure pause control and no aria-live spam.

Jon (EngOps): Backend will expose `/api/sample-projects` with `curated` and `alt_text` fields. For dismissals: server-side flag for logged-in, localStorage for anon, TTL 30 days. I'll add LaunchDarkly flag `onboard_strip_variant`.

Kai (Designer): Copy candidates: Headline: "Start with a demo" / "Try a sample". CTA: "Open sample". Helper: "Working app in minutes." I'll post micro-variants in figma comments.

Maya (Frontend): Prototype CSS tested locally, will add :focus-visible styles and lazy-loading. Will ping when demo branch is up.

Eden (PM): Action items: Maya implement + a11y knobs, Lina to sign off, Jon to add flag + API fields, Kai finalize copy. QA target next Wednesday. Thanks!
